check_gaps.fix: Source table row inventory with use/direction/calibration independent assertions, continuations, group weight members and explicit unresolved canonical mappings.

check_gaps.evidence: v1.6.16 contract exists; t4_coverage lacks supported-direction presence or reported-value preservation checks
check_gaps.fix: Regression expected directions and raw values from audited tables; forbid direction-only rows generating thresholds/scores.

check_gaps.evidence: variable_usage groups variable/scope/DOI, ignores lineage/context; summarize_usage combines reviewed and pending and lacks direction counts
check_gaps.fix: Independent origin key + compatible system/context grouping; separate reviewed/pending use/direction/calibration counts; keep deliberate dropped response with verified model use explicitly labelled.

check_gaps.evidence: docs/dashboard.html renderVfWorklist _uni explicitly appends dashboardData._evDropped; secondary filters lack active-only predicate
check_gaps.fix: Active/dropped status filter default active, history accessible, counts evaluated against same filter; regression autoquarantined record not treated as fresh undecided review.

check_gaps.evidence: t4_coverage class regex catches only numeric strings with named high/medium etc; explicit policy existence passes even hold explanation stale
check_gaps.fix: Every approved structural record disposition: executable, qualitative/directional retained, scope excluded, pending mapping or explicit calibration hold. Validate unknown relationship format is reported rather than dropped.

check_gaps.evidence: review_followups only notes matching figure/table-number/missing; resolved only checks nonempty resolution_evidence_ids
check_gaps.fix: Track all actionable review reasons (relationship_missed/insufficient_context/wrong_table etc); verify linked evidence exists, version and actual corrective field, and unresolved remains visible.

check_gaps.issue: Review UI metadata incomplete for generic directional rows
check_gaps.evidence: Current model-use card improved but instruction text says values and model-use; runtime context needs direction, observed endpoints and group weights; most old records have none
check_gaps.fix: Single card explains use/direction/calibration + exact approval meaning; table image should open correct table page not prose page; snapshot tests for all retained claim types.

check_gaps.evidence: harmonization.combine_profiles requires compatible pool/system/context/unit/score_policy and explicit approval; summarize_at origin dedupe and disagreement/unknown gaps
check_gaps.fix: Retain guards; extend lineage consistency tests from source inventory to origin_id. Do not mix model-use counts into source weights.

check_gaps.fix: Derive source set via T4 evidence_ids -> EV source_id; retain evidence_role and design authority; tea reference must not count Jezeer as tea-host empirical support. Regression alias source ID + effect-record host identity + tea design-only scope.
